title: Kirchberg–Rørdam central-sequence character criterion
exact_target: For every nonzero unital separable complex C*-algebra A and every free ultrafilter $\omega $ on N, is $A\cong A\otimes Z$ equivalent to absence of nonzero characters on the norm central-sequence algebra $A^\omega \cap A\prime $, without nuclearity or simplicity assumptions?
